note: Macro round 29: a file an ungated #[path] module loads stays production beside a test-gated twin, and a schema derived under any non-test cfg_attr stays production. Function-path integer defaults past i64::MAX read as u64. src/bin is a module when the crate root declares mod bin. A route_args error of a cfg-gated route is cfg-gated. Export prefixes and docs_url / redoc_url / spec_url must be ASCII URL path characters (percent escapes allowed). A malformed catch-all marker reads leniently. A cfg(test) route no longer makes an alias ambiguous for the document. A failed selection-marker write skips the prune. The rust-jni-demo diag routes bound recorded key length.
